_comment: All copy + seed data for Borednotes, extracted from the prototype (Borednotes B - MAIN DESIGN.dc.html) so it lives in one place instead of inside the component JS. Move this into a real content source (CMS, DB table, or bundled JSON) before launch. Categories drive both the prompt pool and the UI color system.

If your boredom had a sound, what is it?

Whose business are you minding that isn't yours?
A rumor you'd happily start about yourself?

Rank 3 ways to waste a perfectly good afternoon.

quips._comment: Home mascot speech bubble. Rotates every 4600ms, Home only. Two entries are dynamic and must be computed at render time, not stored as static strings.
static: Back already? Not surprised. Not impressed.
Make it good this time. Low bar. Clear it.
I was busy. Doing nothing. You interrupted.
Dazzle me. Or don't. I've stopped hoping.

weather._comment: One is chosen at random per session in the prototype. Wire to a real weather lookup or drop the line.
weather.rain: It's pouring out. Perfect. Stay in. Rot with me.
weather.sun: Sun's out and you're in here. With me. Bleak.
weather.cloud: Grey out there, grey in here. We match.
weather.cold: Too cold to exist. Good. Entertain me indoors.

seedHits._comment: Prototype seed data for the Greatest Hits archive. ts here is days-ago + HH:MM relative to 'now'; in the real app store an absolute ISO timestamp per entry and compute the relative label at display time (see fmtWhen in the prototype). type is one of text | rank | brain.
